title: Lined Indoor Slippers – Camouflage, Men's 40–47
seo_title: Lined Indoor Slippers in Camouflage – Men's 40–47
seo_description: Lined indoor slippers in a slip-on style with plush lining and a heel strap that keeps them on your foot. Camouflage in khaki or black, men's 40–47.
descriptionHtml:
The floor is cold before the coffee is ready

The hallway floor is ice-cold long before the coffee is ready. The short trip to the patio door is enough for cold socks, and on the way down the basement stairs to get firewood your old slippers slip off on the very first step – the heel is worn down, so you carry on in your socks.

Lined all the way, with a heel strap that keeps them on

This slip-on slipper is lined with plush from heel to toe, so the cold from the floor stays out. The heel strap keeps it on your foot on the stairs and in the hallway instead of sliding off, and the pattern is camouflage – khaki or black, men's sizes 40–47.

Features

  • The cold from the floor stays out – fully lined with plush, from heel to toe.
  • Stays on down the stairs – the heel strap keeps the slipper on your foot instead of sliding off on every step.
  • Step into them in a second – open slip-on style, ready before the coffee has finished brewing.
  • Comes along for the firewood – the chunky sole and heel strap handle a quick trip out to the patio, no change of shoes.
  • Available in your size – men's 40–47, camouflage in khaki or black.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.
